_comment: Practice Arena — konfigurace herni vrstvy Academy (Faze A).
DATA ONLY. Zadny HTML, zadna biologie. Vsechny polozky se GENERUJI z
pathway/model.json a academy_data/lessons.json — tenhle soubor drzi jen
pravidla hry: prahy hodnosti, XP vzorec, decay mastery, kriteria odznaku
a kratke UI texty. build_practice.py to zapece do stranky, verify_practice.py
kontroluje, ze kazde kriterium odznaku ma metriku, kterou engine skutecne
pocita (odznak bez merene metriky by se nedal nikdy ziskat).
Prahy nize jsou NAVRH, ne mereni — po pilotu se prenastavuji tady, ne v kodu.

ranks.name: Curious
ranks.blurb: Recall: what the parts are and which way the arrows point.

ranks.name: Student
ranks.blurb: Mechanism: why the pathway is built the way it is.

ranks.name: Rotation Student
ranks.blurb: Prediction: what happens when you change something.

ranks.name: Graduate
ranks.blurb: Reading data: what a result does and does not support.

ranks.name: Postdoc
ranks.blurb: Judgement: how strong is this evidence, really.

ranks.name: Principal Investigator
ranks.blurb: Design: what would you measure first, and why that.

rankup.note: Rank-up is a short mixed board, not an automatic threshold.

confidence.hint: Say how sure you are before you see the answer. Being right while unsure is worth less than being right while sure — and being sure while wrong is worth nothing.

mastery.note: Mastery is what you can do now; XP is what you have done. Only mastery decays.

badges.name: Predictor
badges.criterion: 8 / 25 / 60 correct predictions made before the reveal, across at least 4 lessons
badges.why: Prediction is the first step that cannot be faked by recognition.

badges.name: Pathway Architect
badges.criterion: Wire a full route correctly at the hard level — direct and indirect steps distinguished, no hints
badges.why: Knowing the parts is not knowing the wiring.

badges.name: Calibrated
badges.criterion: Brier score 0.18 / 0.13 / 0.10 or better over your last 50 judgements
badges.why: The one measurable habit that separates a scientist from a well-read reader.

badges.name: Core Architecture
badges.criterion: Mastery 3 or better on every node the Core lessons cover
badges.why: Coverage, not streaks: the map has no dark patch left in the core.

badges.name: Confounder Spotter
badges.criterion: Name what a result does NOT show, 5 / 15 times
badges.why: Most over-claiming is one unnoticed second explanation.

badges.name: Methods Reader
badges.criterion: 8 / 20 findings in Paper Autopsy across at least 5 kinds of weakness
badges.why: The methods section is where a paper is actually decided.

badges.name: n = 3 Skeptic
badges.criterion: Reject 10 conclusions on sample size — and never reject a well-supported one for small n
badges.why: Scepticism that fires at everything is not scepticism.

badges.name: Honest Unknown
badges.criterion: 10 correct "insufficient evidence" calls, with no settled claim wrongly marked open
badges.why: Knowing where the field stops is knowledge, not a gap in it.

badges.name: Source Hunter
badges.criterion: 20 correct study IDs, at least 3 of them weakening the claim
badges.why: A claim you cannot trace is a claim you are repeating.

badges.name: Falsifier
badges.criterion: Pick the discriminating experiment before the confirming one, in 3 challenges
badges.why: The experiment worth paying for is the one that can come out either way.

games.name: Daily 5
games.blurb: Two you have seen, two new, one a level up. Three minutes.

games.name: Signal Sprint
games.blurb: Sixty seconds of arrows: does this one activate or inhibit?

games.name: Wire the Pathway
games.blurb: Rebuild a route from loose parts — and get the direct steps right.

games.name: Perturbation Lab
games.blurb: Set the controls, predict the readout before it is revealed.

games.name: What It Doesn't Show
games.blurb: One result, four readings. Which one the evidence will not carry?

copy.hubLede: Five games built on the Atlas's own pathway model. Points reward calibration, not speed — and nothing here rewards simply showing up.
copy.progressLede: Your progress is the pathway itself. Grey nodes are the ones you have not been tested on yet; hatched ones are questions the field has not closed, so they never fill in.
copy.noJs: This page needs JavaScript for scoring and for saving progress in this browser. The practice questions themselves are below in full, with answers — the page is readable and usable without it.
copy.storageNote: Progress lives in this browser only. No account, nothing sent anywhere. Export it if you want to move it.
copy.openNote: Open questions never reach full mastery. That is not a bug in the game — the field has not closed them.
